scope: Complete source-cell pricing on the saved amplitude interval only. A global scalar norm bound additionally uses the separately accepted lower/high amplitude branches for the same operator and requires independent union audit.
proof: Each R3 frozen local gate is invariant under y(r)=y0+E02(r-r0). Its transported outer price is an exact r quadratic plus u^2-2ell*u and a convex-kappa/convex-shape corner price. The exact r maximum includes an interior vertex when needed. Each source cell chooses one accepted native or R3 bound; the largest cell cap bounds the whole finite continuous cover.
